title: Mafia: The Old Country
description: Mafia: The Old Country is a cinematic action-adventure game set in 1900s Sicily, exploring the origins of organized crime through a focused narrative campaign. Combining detailed environments, cinematic presentation, stealth, gunplay, and close-quarters combat, the game delivers a demanding modern PC experience. The gameplay showcased on SPCBM is captured in real time using Ultra graphics settings on high-end PC hardware.
